stem: A motorcycle was bought in Dhaka for 240,000 taka. Its value \(V\), in taka, \(t\) years after purchase is modeled by \(V = 240{,}000(0.75)^{t}\). According to the model, after how many years will the motorcycle be worth 101,250 taka?

explanation.A: Incorrect. This treats the loss as a fixed 60,000 taka per year (\(240{,}000 - 101{,}250 \approx 2.3\) years' worth); the model multiplies by \(0.75\) each year.
explanation.C: Incorrect. After 4 years the value is \(240{,}000 \cdot 0.75^{4} \approx 75{,}938\) taka.
explanation.D: Incorrect. This is the ratio \(\frac{V}{240{,}000}\), not the number of years.

verify:
t = symbols('t')
sol = solve(Eq(240000*Rational(3, 4)**t, 101250), t)
assert sol == [3]
ans = 3
assert value(choices[answer]) == ans
assert all(value(choices[k]) != ans for k in choices if k != answer)
